correctness.rationale: Exact finite certificates enumerate all 145 forbidden matchings and all 1073 faces, verify 530 disjoint acyclic Hasse pairs, compute the signed integral Morse boundary with seven unit entries, and verify the induced S5 character for all 120 elements. The resulting CW space is a wedge of ten 3-spheres with one primitive 4-cell relation, hence exactly nine 3-spheres. Independent finite checks concern the entire finite claimed graph; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The canonical non-bipartite Petersen graph is a natural first benchmark for the recent general/bipartite non-matching literature. The exact integral homotopy type is stronger than general Leray bounds, and the complete S5 augmentation-character identification is a motivated structural equivariant invariant unavailable from the nine-dimensional rank alone. No larger graph-family theorem is claimed.
